payload.tension: The passage states elders, pay, accusations, and public correction. Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching. Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
